big_case.notes: Independent legal review of NLRB statutory interpretations has national relevance, but this petition arises from an unpublished, evidence-dependent classification ruling about producers at one station. The petition itself identifies subsequent circuit authority accepting independent legal review; the denial establishes no new Supreme Court rule.

leakage.notes: Forward run on October 30, before the November 16 resolution. Of 34 calls, 33 are captured and the general Loper Bright web search is unobserved. That query concerns agency factfinding, not this petition, and cannot be credited as an observed empty search. Other queries concern provisioned documents, historical statistics, unrelated denial priors, Loper Bright, and Multimedia KSDK. No own-case outcome exposure appears.
